title: Test Preview
description: A short, unscored walkthrough of the testing tools: a few Reading and Writing questions and a few Math questions.

questions.stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?

questions.passage: Wind turbines are usually painted white to blend with the sky, but a Norwegian wind farm painted one blade of each turbine black. Over the following years, bird collisions at those turbines fell by roughly 70 percent compared with all-white turbines nearby. The researchers suggest that [[blank]]
questions.explanation: A visible contrasting blade would explain why birds avoided the rotor.

questions.stem: Line $\ell$ is defined by $y = 4x + 1$. Line $k$ is perpendicular to line $\ell$ in the $xy$-plane. What is the slope of line $k$?
The population of a town is modeled by the function $P(t) = 200(1.04)^t$, where $t$ is the number of years after 2020. By what percent does the quantity increase each year?
questions.explanation: The base $1.04 = 1 + 0.04$, so the yearly increase is $4\%$.

questions.stem: For a set of data, a line of best fit is given by $y = 4x + 24$, where $x$ is the number of hours a student studied and $y$ is the predicted score on a quiz. According to the model, what is the predicted quiz score for a student who studied for 4 hours?
